Testing Procedures 
 ( P1 Y1 )
Approved Date: 17 Jan 2004
Date to be Reviewed: Jan 2009
مقدمة

QCI and 
QSE are Digital Input Cards, each of 16 Channel, from switches. QCI indicates temp., 
pressure, diff. switches and QSE indicates the events time of switches working

This document 
outlines the testing procedures P1 for QCI and 
QSE carts, 
which must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above 
title block

المسودة الأولى بدأها المهندس. Ahmed 
Esmail Fouad & eng. Khalil Ahmed Awwad, QCI tested at 05 
May 2002, QSE tested at 01 May 2003 and revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control eng. Abdel Menem Al Emam, accepted by general
director: eng Mohamed Abdel Ghafar, and approved by 
eng. Yosery 
Mohamed Salama Head Sector of EL-Aresh Power Station.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والمؤهلين 
يجب أن تحمل أشياء الصيانة 
فئة السلامة المناسبة.

سياج أمان (حبل) مع علامات التحذير 
مطلوب المحيطة بمنطقة العمل.
Wear the safety helmet and shoes.
Unit must be shutdown.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Steps to 
Prepare for test

Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU Cabinet.

Using 
 cabinet Termination Identify the location for the desired Card.

items:
Review 
 technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU Cabinet.

Using 
 cabinet Termination Identify the location for the desired Card.

sections.text: Start Test

Using cabinet Termination list for each card Identify the 
 input wires for the first channel

Using the screw driver remove this two wires and isolate by 
 tape.
Make Jumper to test the channel.

Using radio to see if the contact closed in CCR ''Central 
 Control Room''

If the reading is Ok, repeat steps 1 to 5 for the another 15 
 channels.

If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the 
 Card.
